description: Client-side script for managing firmware upgrade UI and logic in a device management web interface.

methods.name: get_fwinfo_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of device firmware info, updates UI elements.

methods.name: get_fwinfo_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed retrieval of device firmware info, handles error such as logout on 403.

methods.name: get_fwinfo_version
methods.description: Initiates request to get device firmware info.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initializes page data and UI.

methods.name: check_upload_file
methods.description: Validates selected firmware file before upload.

methods.name: validation_file_name
methods.description: Checks if filename has valid firmware extension (.bin or .img).

methods.name: clean_fw_path
methods.description: Resets firmware file input field.

methods.name: upload_fw_file
methods.description: Uploads firmware file via AJAX and processes response.

methods.name: upgrade_fw_process
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade process via AJAX POST.

methods.name: reflash_process_bar
methods.description: Displays progress bar during firmware upgrade.

methods.name: upgrade_success_cb
methods.description: Handles successful firmware upgrade callback.

methods.name: upgrade_error_cb
methods.description: Handles firmware upgrade failure callback.

methods.name: ota_upgrade_fw
methods.description: Initiates OTA firmware upgrade.

methods.name: get_fwv_success_cb
methods.description: Handles success response for firmware version check.

methods.name: get_fwv_error_cb
methods.description: Handles error response for firmware version check.

methods.name: check_fw_version
methods.description: Checks current firmware version against available updates.

methods.name: auto_upgrade
methods.description: Sets auto-upgrade mode.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Handles success response for getting device object data.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Handles error response for getting device object data.

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Fetches device object data.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Handles success response for setting device object data.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Handles error response for setting device object data.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sets device object data.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves current configuration changes.
